description: This Java source file defines an abstract handler class for managing complex observations in the OpenMRS medical records system. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, and purging complex observation data, handling file storage, and interacting with storage services, with utility functions for parsing data keys and titles. The class uses dependency injection for required services and includes license and copyright notices.

classes.name: AbstractHandler
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for handling complex observation data in OpenMRS, including retrieval, storage, and deletion of binary data associated with observations, along with utility methods for data key parsing and view support.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves complex data for a given observation and view, populating the observation's complexData property.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves complex data associated with an observation to storage and updates the observation with the storage key.

methods.name: purgeComplexData
methods.description: Deletes the complex data associated with an observation from storage.

methods.name: getObsDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path configured for storing complex observation files.

methods.name: parseDataKey
methods.description: Extracts the storage key for the complex data from the observation's valueComplex property.

methods.name: parseDataTitle
methods.description: Extracts the title of the complex data from the observation.

methods.name: injectMissingMetadata
methods.description: Populates missing metadata for the complex data by fetching it from storage.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns the list of supported views for complex observation rendering (empty by default).

methods.name: supportsView
methods.description: Checks if a specific view is supported.
